_comment: Shared contract for stripping Whisper non-speech annotations before the transcript gate. HallucinationFilter.stripNonSpeechAnnotations (Swift) and strip_non_speech_annotations (backend/app/nlp/hallucination.py) must both map every text to its expected value. Cases marked observed came from the 2026-10-27 cockpit acceptance run and the offline decode probe.
